Premium features for the ultimate in testing flexibility.
Are you looking for the smallest humidity chambers possible to get your testing done? Still need all the capabilities of larger chambers, though? This is the model series for you! Available in two sizes, the smaller models are the smallest humidity chambers in the world!      
Easy to install and own:   
 The SH models are small enough be placed underneath a benchtop, or on top.       
 Designed for integration with other test equipment to make a complete test stand.       
 The smaller models run on standard 115V power, enabling easy installation anywhere.       
 These humidity chambers include an removable water storage tank, avoiding the need for water hook-ups. The tank will last up to a week at 85°C/85% and can be refilled without interrupting the test. (Option for direct water connection is available.)       
 Extremely quiet operation as low as 52 dba, suitable for quiet labs or offices.

Features of SH Series Benchtop Chambers
ESPEC'S EXCLUSIVE PROGRAM CONTROLLER:        
 User-friendly touch-screen operation        
 Three different ‘constant mode’ settings can be saved for single-setting operation        
 Store 40 cycling programs, with up to 99 steps each        
 Programs may be written on a PC and uploaded via USB        
 The trend-graph display shows a record of setpoints and actual values        
 Operation data can be downloaded as needed, or continually, to USB        
 System alarms are stored in memory for historical review        
 Built-in timer functions allow the chamber to be started or shut down automatically        
 Pattern Manager Lite PC software for program editing and datalog viewing/exporting, to support USB functionality        
 Also included is Web Manager remote monitor/control via Ethernet/browser         
CHAMBER DESIGN FEATURES:        
 Premium design with a space-saving footprint and quiet operation suitable for offices and small labs        
 One 1" diameter cable port on the right side (Note: previous model series also included standard port on left)        
 Removable humidity water tank for SH models (direct water connection optional)        
 One adjustable stainless steel shelf        
 Temperature (& humidity) output terminals        
SAFETY FEATURES:        
 Three levels of overheat protection        
 Humidifier boil-dry protector for SH models        
 Specimen power supply control terminal        
 Main power circuit breaker
